published_mt5_english_context.note: Published reference scores. Different fitted models and documented snapshot/protocol differences prevent matched paired inference.

limitations: Intervals resample parallel English review clusters and condition on the fitted models. Training-seed sample SD is separate.
Gemma has approximately 8B total parameters including embeddings and a different precision/runtime policy. This compares trained systems, not isolated architecture effects.
Gemma final adapter weight files are retained in Drive and absent from the results-only archive. Their hashes cannot be independently checked from this archive.
Gemma results-only training metadata identifies 474 updates and seeds, but does not contain the full training arguments or a runner snapshot.
Cross-domain repeated results cover Food and Phone, English and Swahili. The historical six-language matrix used different fitted adapters.
Reproduced mT5 uses development-selected checkpoints, while these Qwen and Gemma adapters use the final three-epoch checkpoints.
The weighted intervention was informed by Food development/error evidence. Gemma Laptop evaluates the original objective.
